initialExam.title: KVS PRT (Primary Teacher) 2026
initialExam.description: KVS Primary Teacher recruitment for teaching Classes 1-5 in Kendriya Vidyalayas across India.
initialExam.syllabus: Part-I: Hindi (10Q), English (10Q), GK & Current Affairs (10Q), Reasoning (10Q), Computer Literacy (10Q). Part-II: Subject concerned (100Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 150 questions, 150 marks, 3 hours. Demo Teaching + Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Demo Teaching → Interview → Final Selection
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit kvsangathan.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Children Education, Summer/Winter vacation, Transfer benefits
